effects.description: 2 seconds after X moves, O (the computer) plays: win if it can, else block X's win, else center, else a corner, else an edge. dedupeKey re-arms every move so resetting or superseding cancels a stale pending move.

tests.description: X wins the top row via index mutations
after X's first move it is O's turn; O's computer move is scheduled by a timer effect and does not fire synchronously within this test
full board with no line is a draw
